text: The Corporations Nominating Panel will select candidates to be interviewed for appointment to the Toronto Community Housing Corporation Board of Directors. The Corporations Nominating Panel will conduct interviews at its next meeting and recommend one candidate to City Council for appointment.

The Corporations Nominating Panel: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the Toronto Community Housing Corporation Board of Directors: Candidate TCH2-359 Candidate TCH2-306 Candidate TCH2-251 Candidate TCH2-387 Candidate TCH2-371 Candidate TCH2-378 Candidate TCH2-278 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1a, 1b, and 2 to the report (May 29, 2024) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Community Housing Corporation Board of Directors.
